subject: Combining  2 half days' data as a single day of 24h?

messages.author: ffd4a53024d34dff
messages.subject: Combining  2 half days' data as a single day of 24h?
parts:
Hi!
I'm processing AX3 data in cwa and participants from my sample wore the devices for 8 calendar days, for  example from Wednesday  starting at noon, until next Wed ending at noon.  The code runs well, but as expected, I get the day summary data of 8 days, where the first and the last days (both Wednesdays) have around 12 valid hours each, corresponding to after noon and before noon, respectively. I'd like to combine the 12-hours data corresponding to day 1 with the 12-hours data from day 8  as a single day,  to have a total of 7 full days with 24 hours. Any advice on how to do this with GGIR??
Thanks in advance!

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Combining  2 half days' data as a single day of 24h?
parts:
This is not possible, and to be honest I am also not sure you should be trying it.

The person level variables in the GGIR part 2 output that have fullRecording in their name use all the available data in the recording, including the first and last day. All other variables assume that you have enough data from a single day.

Usually studies who start- and end the recording in the middle of the day expect the participant to travel to a clinic on those days, which is an extra reason not to rely too heavily on those recording days.

Have you seen other accelerometer software including those first and last day?
Best, Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees
Independent consultant
https://accelting.com/
